normalized.result: The labeled "Read later" button is clearer to me. The clock icon produces the same result — the "Added to Read later" confirmation, the "Saved for later" state, and the sidebar count — so it works fine, but on its own a small clock isn't obvious about what it does. Words spell it out plainly, and I don't have to guess. So I'd go with the labeled button. Either produces the right outcome, but the label is the one I'd find easiest.
